name: DUT Hub (4-port PCB test & programming tool)

mentions.name: DUT Hub (4-port PCB test & programming tool)
mentions.description: A 4-port automated PCB test and programming tool. It provides a 4-channel DUT interface with individual power control (TPS22992), a JTAG multiplexer for programming, per-channel voltage/current power monitoring via PAC1954, Raspberry Pi Pico control logic, USB-CDC host communication (one port per DUT), 1.8V-5V IO support, and MicroPython support for test script automation.
mentions.problem: The author needed a way to produce a batch of PCBs efficiently and couldn't find a solution that was flexible and didn't cost many thousands of dollars.
mentions.audience: Needed a flexible, affordable way to produce PCBs in batch; existing solutions lacked flexibility or cost many thousands of dollars.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built (and currently testing) a 4 port automated PCB test & programming tool. I needed a way to produce a bunch of PCBs efficiently and couldn't find a solution that was flexible and didn't cost many thousands of dollars.
